text:
Which statement about the Sun is correct?
A
The Sun consists of mainly carbon and nitrogen.
B
The Sun is the largest planet in the Solar System.
C
The Sun is a medium-sized star.
D
The Sun radiates most of its energy in the gamma-ray region of the electromagnetic
spectrum.
